name: Personal Branding Playful
tagline: An original 18-page creative-practice deck with expressive type, fresh ribbon artwork and practical collaboration structures.

palette.description: Cream and black with expressive pink, red, yellow, green and blue. All geometric artwork is newly authored.

best_for: Creative professionals introducing a point of view, connected services, a practical process, illustrative projects and a collaboration proposal.
avoid_for: Formal board reports, dense scientific data or a restrained corporate voice. Keep expressive typography and use concise copy.

typography.style: Original static Savate (2015 MIT), Poppins 500/600 (OFL), Unbounded 700 (OFL 1.1). Independently authored type scale, fresh native artwork and original composition; source artwork and page geometry are not reused.

source_inspiration.notes: The earlier source-inspired study is superseded. This version uses independently authored compositions, CSS, native vector artwork and original fictional demonstration copy. No Pitch-exported DOM/CSS, source custom SVG art, source brand logo or source photography remains. Only the broad editorial/creative genre was retained. Actual font licenses and each editorial photo source/author/hash are documented in FONT-LICENSES and ASSET-LICENSES; no standalone reuse grant for the historical Pitch design is asserted or needed for this independent implementation.
